primitives.meaning: Facts, authoritative state, derived state and display state are separate concepts.
Independent lifecycle dimensions are modeled as orthogonal state axes instead of one overloaded enum.
A guard decides whether a transition may start; evidence proves what actually occurred.
Requested, launched, human-reported, system-verified and completed semantics must not be collapsed.
The same idempotency key and intent replays the prior result; the same key with a different intent is a conflict.
Workflow history is append-only; correction, restore and cancellation are new events rather than history mutation.
Hold is an open state, not completion, and a deferred workflow carries an explicit resume_at or equivalent due condition.
Current projection and immutable event history are distinct and reconcilable.
Opening event plus due rule plus closing event(s) forms an obligation with escalation on breach.
primitives.notes: Supported by the schema but not mandatory for all domain workflows until a second independent project verifies it.

primitives.meaning: A workflow may bind to a newer subject revision without changing lifecycle state when explicit evidence proves the re-observation and the domain permits it.
primitives.notes: AI Core Work Ledger REOBSERVED semantics are being parity-tested in SHADOW before broader adoption.

primitives.meaning: When a parent requirement revision changes, child work evidence may be invalidated and the child lifecycle reset explicitly rather than silently reusing stale completion.
primitives.notes: Observed in OrderStore revise semantics; not COMMON_ADOPTED until another independent domain verifies it.

facts.description: Whether VERIFYING captured a verification revision, including a null revision value.

guards.description: Candidate event project must match current work project.
Normal transition must preserve current subject revision.
REOBSERVE must bind a different non-null subject revision.
If a verified revision exists, candidate subject revision must match it.
Verified-path transition requires a previously captured verification revision.
Candidate ledger event must contain at least one evidence reference.
Candidate subject revision must be a non-null 40-hex revision.

commands.intent: Start or return work to in-progress

events.meaning: Work re-observed a newer subject revision

workflows.description: Shadow model of OrderStore child-task coordination. Parent Order status remains a derived aggregate projection and heartbeat remains a lease fact update.

states.description: Task is claimed under an active or expirable lease.
Task stopped with an explicit blocked reason.
A result was reported for the current requirement revision; it is not canonical completion.

facts.description: Requested actor is in the current assignable actor registry.
Requested actor is the task's assigned actor.
No unexpired task lease currently exists.
Lease is active and actor/token match the task.
Every prior task in the order has REPORTED state.
Command revision and lease revision equal the current order requirement revision.
Report summary/evidence satisfy current OrderStore input constraints.
Required transition reason satisfies current OrderStore text constraints.
